questions: Section 11 charges a DUI conviction 50 debits but also refers a recent motoring conviction to underwriting judgement. For a DUI conviction dated 2025 on an application dated September 2026 - roughly one year old - does this desk postpone the file until a stated period has elapsed since the conviction, or rate it now? If it postpones, how long must have passed since the conviction date before the file is ratable?
If this desk rates rather than postpones a DUI conviction about one year old, is the section 11 charge of 50 debits the whole charge, or does recency add further debits on top of the 50?

On a file whose only adverse feature is a single DUI conviction about one year old, with normal liver enzymes and no alcohol treatment history, does this desk require a modifier - a flat extra, and if so in which band, or an exclusion rider naming a hazard - or is the debit charge alone sufficient?

This applicant's A1c is 6.2 with no diabetes diagnosis, total cholesterol 216 with ratio 4.5, BMI 25.1 and BP 125/74 - each inside its zero-debit band but several near the top of it. Under the section 16 referral for combinations of cardiac risk factors, does this desk add any debits for that combination, or are factors sitting inside a zero-debit band charged as zero regardless of how many there are?
